content: 'Etsahu nuiwarimama
Merikɨtsɨ 'ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ 'Etsahu nuiwarimama, meta 'Erumi mɨtitewakaita.
'Etsahu, 'ukari Kanani kiekatari pɨwarutiwitɨ: 'Ara kaniutiwitɨni 'Eruni niweya Heti tewiyari, 'Ahuriwama kaniutiwitɨni 'Ahana niweya Tsiwehuni teukarieya heweu tewiyari,
meta Watsemati kaniutiwitɨni 'Itsimaheri niweya Newayuti taruya.
'Ikɨ mepɨniwemama 'Etsahu: 'Ara hamatɨa kaneyexeiya 'Eripaxi. Watsemati hamatɨa kaneyexeiya Xehueri.
'Ahuriwama matɨa mekaniwarayexeiya Kehutsi, Karani meta Kure. 'Ikɨ tɨɨri 'Etsahu muwarayexei mekanihɨkɨtɨni Kanani kwieyaritsie 'uyeikatɨ.

Hikɨ 'arikeke 'Etsahu kaneyani yu'ɨitama yuniwema meta yunaime teɨteri memiparewiekai warawitɨtɨ, yutewama wara'arietɨ naime yupiinite Kanani kwieyaritsie mɨtiukaxeiyakai, xeime kwieyaritsie kaniuyupata Kakuwu hamatɨa mɨka'uyeikanikɨ.
Yuhutatɨ waɨkawa mepɨtehexeiyakai yupiinite 'ayumieme mepɨkayɨwawekai 'axeikɨa memukuteni, 'ɨxa pumawekai watewama wahetsiemieme.
Mɨpaɨ katininuani 'Etsahu, metatsiere 'Erumi mɨtitewakai, hɨritsie Tsehixi kwieyaritsie.
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni 'Etsahu nuiwarimama, 'erumitsixi wa'ukiyari, hɨritsie Tsehixi kwieyaritsie memɨtamarixɨ.
Waniwema mɨpaɨ mekatenitetewakaitɨni: 'Eripaxi 'Ara nu'aya, 'Etsahu 'ɨyaya, Xehueri Watsemati nu'aya, 'Etsahu 'ɨyaya.
'Eripaxi niwemama mekanakɨne: Temani, 'Umaxi, Tsepuhu, Katani meta Kenatsi.
'Eripaxi yutuxeri Timina hamatɨa xeime kanayexeiya nunutsi 'Amareki katiniterɨwa. Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ 'Ara teukarimama mekanakɨne, 'Etsahu 'ɨyaya.
Xehueri niwemama mekanakɨne: Nakati, Tsera, Tsama meta Mitsaha. 'Ikɨ Watsemati teukarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨni, 'Etsahu 'ɨyaya.
Hipatɨta 'Etsahu niwemama 'Ahuriwama hetsiemieme, 'Ahana niweya Tsiwehuni teukarieya, mekanihɨkɨtɨni: Kehutsi, Karani meta Kure.
'Ikɨ memanuyetei mekanakɨne 'Etsahu nuiwarimama wahetsie: 'Eripaxi 'Etsahu matɨarieya nuiwarimama memanuyetei mepakɨ: Temani, 'Umaxi, Tsepuhu, Kenatsi,
Kure, Katani meta 'Amareki. 'Ikɨ memanuyetei mekanakɨne 'Eripaxi nuiwarimama wahetsie 'Erumi kwieyaritsie, mɨkɨ yunaitɨ 'Ara teukarimama xeikɨa mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.

'Etsahu nu'aya Xehueri niwemama, memanuyetei mekanakɨne Nakati, Tsera, Tsama meta Mitsaha. 'Ikɨ memanuyetei mekanakɨne Xehueri nuiwarimama wahetsie 'Erumi kwieyaritsie, yunaitɨ mɨkɨ Watsemati teukarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, 'Etsahu 'ɨyaya mɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
'Ahuriwama niwemamata 'Ahana niweya, 'Etsahu 'ɨyaya, memanuyetei mekanakɨne Kehutsi, Karani meta Kure.
'Ikɨ 'Etsahu nuiwarimama mepakɨ, metatsiere 'Erumi mɨtitewakai, meta yuxexuitɨ nuiwarite wahetsie memanuyetekai.
'Ikɨ Tsehixi nuiwarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨni hureu tewiyari, mana memɨtamakai: Rutani, Tsuwari, Tsiwehuni, 'Ahana,
Ritsuni, 'Etsexi meta Ritsani. 'Ikɨ Tsehixi nuiwarimama wahetsie memanuyetei mekanakɨne hureutsixi wahetsie 'Erumi kwieyaritsie.
Rutani niwemama mekanakɨne: Huri, Humani matɨa. Rutani xeime yu'iwa 'uka kanexeiyakaitɨni Timina titewakame.
Tsuwari niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: 'Ariwani, Manakati, 'Ewari, Tsepuhu meta 'Unami.
Tsiwehuni niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: 'Ayaha meta 'Ahana. 'Ikɨ 'imatɨrieka mieme haa xɨkame mutaxei kanihɨkɨtɨni makumawetsie hetineikatɨkaime, yupaapa puxurimama wahɨnetɨ Tsiwehuni.
'Ahana niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: Ritsuni meta 'Ahuriwama, 'Ahana niweya.
Ritsuni niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: Hemɨrani, 'Etsiwani, 'Itɨrani meta Kerani.
'Etsexi niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: Wirani, Tsawani meta 'Akani.
Ritsani niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: 'Utsi meta 'Arahani.
Hureutsixi wa'ukiyarima mepakɨ Rutani, Tsuwari, Tsiwehuni, 'Ahana,
Ritsuni, 'Etsexi meta Ritsani. Mɨkɨ yuxexuitɨ yunuiwari hetsie memanuyetei mepakɨ Tsehixi kwieyaritsie.
Te'aitamete 'Erumi kwieyaritsie
'Ixaheritsixi te'aitamete mekawarexeiyakaku 'akuxi, 'ikɨ mepanuka'ui 'Erumi kwieyaritsie:
Wera Wehuxi nu'aya 'Erumi katiniuta'aita. Kiekarieya Rinawa katinitewakaitɨni.
Kepauka Wera mumɨ, hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Kuwawi Tsera nu'aya, Wutsira meyeyakai.
Kepauka Kuwawi mumɨ, hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Kutsani Temani kiekame.
Kepauka Kutsani mumɨ hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Harari Werari nu'aya. Mɨkɨ mariyanitsixi mɨwara'iwaxɨ Muhawi kwieyaritsie. Kiekarieya 'Awiti pɨtitewakai.
Kepauka mumɨ Harari, hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Tsamɨra, Matsireka kiekariyaritsie kiekame.
Kepauka mumɨ Tsamɨra, hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Tsahuri, 'aki Xekuwuti manuyeka kiekame.
Kepauka mumɨ Tsahuri, hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Wahari-Kanani 'Akuwuxi nu'aya.
Kepauka Wahari-Kanani mumɨ 'Akuwuxi nu'aya, hetsienamieme katiniuta'aita Hara. Kiekarieya katinitewakaitɨni Pahu. 'Ɨyaya katinitewakaitɨni Mehitaweri, Matereri kaninu'ayatɨni, Metsawi teukarieya.
Mɨpaɨ mepɨtetetewakai me'anuyetetɨmemakɨ 'Etsahu nuiwarimama, yuxexuitɨ yutɨɨriyama mewarexeiyatɨ meta yukwie: Timina, 'Ariwa, Keteti,
'Ahuriwama, 'Eraha, Pinuni,
Kenatsi, Temani, Miwitsaxi,
Makirieri meta 'Irami. 'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ memanuyeyaxixɨ 'Erumi kwieyaritsie, kememɨte'ukutetɨkatei.
'Ikɨ 'Etsahu 'erumitsixi wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni.
